title: Error Siphon: Diagnostics Workflow for Payload Forensics
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Goal: Design a compact, scannable workflow in the Redwood Console that surfaces failed request clusters, allows rapid payload triage, and guides engineers through retry hypotheses without losing context.

Background: Operators today jump between the request table, raw payload viewers, and separate retry tooling. This causes lost context (config, model variant, routing tier) and slows down incident resolution. The proposed "Error Siphon" is a left-to-right diagnostic funnel that progressively filters failed requests, highlights representative payloads, and exposes retry controls and taxonomy-driven suggestions.

Scope:
- A funnel view that groups failures by error taxonomy and retry outcome (transient, permanent, throttled).
- Representative payload card with compact diffs, KV cache snapshot, and model metadata.
- Inline retry orchestration panel (canary retry presets, backoff, target model variant).
- Lightweight timeline of retries and outcomes for that bucket.
- Quick links to open full request traces in the tracing panel.

Out of scope:
- Full incident timeline playground (separate project).
- Deep storage/long-term forensic exports (those remain in Audit/Exports).

Design constraints: Must be compact to fit in a 1280px-wide window, keyboard-navigable, and accessible (contrast, screen reader labels). Designs should assume dataset anonymity requirements: payload previews must mask PII by default and show a redaction toggle with clear audit trail.
acceptance_criteria: Funnel groups failures by taxonomy+outcome and shows counts and % change vs. baseline
Selecting a group loads a representative payload card with: timestamp, model id+variant, route, request headers summary, and a 3-line payload preview with highlighted diffs
Inline retry controls appear for the selected group with canary presets and an estimated token-cost preview
Timeline renders last 5 retries for the group with outcome badges (success, retryable-failure, permanent) and links to traces
All UI states have keyboard focus order and aria-labels; redaction toggle present and persists per-user
comments: 2025-02-13 — Aisha Kumar: Initial exploratory sketches attached. Emphasis on keeping payload card height under 220px so the funnel list remains visible. Asked Eng to confirm acceptable metadata surfaces.

2025-02-17 — Priya Shah (Eng): Confirmed model id, route, and kernel tag are available in request metadata. KV snapshot may be large; recommend showing first 8 entries and a 'view full snapshot' link.
2025-02-21 — Miguel Ortega: UX review notes: prefer left-aligned funnel counts, add microcopy explaining why we surface 'most representative' payload (heuristic: highest frequency + recent).

2025-02-25 — Design critique: Need clearer affordance for redaction toggle; legal asked that the toggle includes a per-session disclosure banner. Also, indicate estimated cost only when user expands advanced controls.
2025-03-02 — QA (Lena Park): Asked for deterministic keyboard shortcuts for expanding the payload card and triggering a canary retry. Will add to accessibility checklist.
mockups_review_notes: Stakeholders liked the funnel metaphor but requested a secondary compact mode for monitors (single-line group rows). Engineering flagged potential perf hit if we compute representative diffs on the fly; propose precompute diffs during ingestion for top error buckets. PM wants the ability to pin a payload card to the right rail for cross-group comparison.
accessibility_considerations: All interactive elements require aria-labels. Payload preview must be navigable by screen reader with 'expand diff' semantics. Contrast ratio for badges >= 4.5:1. Redaction toggle must be reachable by keyboard and announce current state to assistive tech.
acceptance_tests: Create synthetic failure clusters in staging and validate funnel groups appear with correct counts
Select bucket -> representative payload card loads with masked PII by default; toggle reveals redacted content and writes an audit log entry
Trigger a canary retry from UI; confirm request routed to designated variant and outcome is recorded in timeline
next_steps: Incorporate eng feedback on KV snapshot sizing and add 'view full snapshot' CTA
Deliver compact row variant and accessibility annotations by 2025-02-28
Hand off finalized mocks and interaction spec to frontend with a 2-week implementation window
Add telemetry events: funnel_group_viewed, payload_card_toggled_redaction, canary_retry_submitted
